purpose: Complete active final-policy reach audit for tooling, tests, configs, docs, generated resources, package roots, generic policies, and the dormant policy command front door.

tree.head: 8f7ed4c4b98c112429c3918483f3a172f66ae184
tree.note: Captured in the shared world-aware-tools audit worktree. Source and planner probes were read-only. The gate-scope integration test was already modified by another lane and was not touched. Recheck counts on the settled tree before final closure.

law.genericPopulationRule: Generic policies include tooling and test-tooling unless an explicit, proven population rule excludes them.
law.resourceRule: Unpopulated resource requests contribute no authored path; demand requests receive their subject at the call. The named classifications in contract/resource-declaration.ts govern this distinction.
law.commandContract: The final-policy command supports list, explain, JSON, and file, folder, package, project, changed, and whole scope through one planner and executor.

denominator.derivation: loadGateCorpus(root) followed by planPolicyArgv(root, ['--list','--json'], corpus); the list returned all 347 loaded policies. RunManifest states that final policies have no dormant state.

authored.intent: All authored TypeScript and TSX across product, tooling, tests, and scripts, except the two separately governed open roots.

exclusions.evidence: contract/population.ts excludes it from @authored with an OPEN QUESTION reason and requires a policy that needs it to declare it explicitly.

authored.falseCleanRisk: A generic policy using a product-only composite would silently miss 1,399 tooling and 3,005 test sources. No audited generic policy had that defect.

all.intent: Every compiler candidate, including the open showcase and default-content roots.

resourceOnlyPolicies.law: population.of:none is deliberate for policies whose evidence plane is entirely resource-backed.

evidence: `node tooling/src/verify/cli.ts structure --explain --check brand-in-name-position --json` refuses --explain as unknown.
`pnpm verify --list --json` lists verification stages, not final policies.
Production search finds planPolicyArgv and executePolicyPlan only in exports/comments; runStructure still uses parseStructureTail and runFinalPass directly.
confirmedRepairs.risk: The implemented six-scope/list/explain/JSON planner is not reachable by operators, so the command contract is false despite green unit tests.
smallestCanonicalRepair: Keep `structure` as the single final-policy command; preserve `verify --list` as the stage registry.
Parse `--void/--reason` as a disjoint early tombstone branch.
Load the corpus once and call planPolicyArgv for every inspection or run request.
Render list/explain from PolicyRosterEntry without opening a run slot.
For a run plan, build one shared Project and call executePolicyPlan, then feed its pass into the existing reconciliation, report, slot, and console machinery.
Record scope, tier, strictScope, and requested identities in RunManifest. Publish the fixed pointer only for whole scope, all-policy selection, and a verdict.
JSON run output must serialize the same canonical StructureReport or a stable envelope containing it, not a second report schema.

evidence: planPolicyArgv(root, ['--whole','--json'], corpus) returns exit 2: resource policy no-manual-memo-compiler-health received an empty resource population.
policy-plan.ts refuses every resource policy whose resolved authored resource paths are empty.
resource-declaration.ts explicitly names installed-package, authored-path, and authored-text as unpopulated kinds.

Direct production dispatch runs no-manual-memo-compiler-health with source 1/resource 0 and an installed-package receipt of 1; tooling-instrument-proof runs source 1985/resource 0 and an authored-path receipt of 9.
confirmedRepairs.risk: Whole planning fails on the first valid unpopulated resource consumer, blocking the command front door and making zero authored paths look like missing evidence.
smallestCanonicalRepair: Validate the declared resource capability rather than requiring a nonzero authored resource path count.
Consume the exported unpopulated-kind classification instead of respelling its members.
Keep runtime acquisition, demand fences, and receipt refusal in ResourceHost and the production pass.
Continue refusing a genuinely empty resource evidence plane.

evidence: The policy header says @inference was added on 2026-09-20, while POPULATION omits @inference.
Current population: 6,324 sources and 58 raw findings. Adding @inference: 6,436 sources and 90 raw findings, exactly 32 added inference findings.
The added findings include canonical sessionId and modelId positions across agent-sdk, local-light, and error surfaces, refuting the header's clean-seal claim on the current tree.
confirmedRepairs.risk: New inference port signatures can use bare strings at canonical brand names without this policy seeing them.
smallestCanonicalRepair: Adjudicate or remediate all 32 live inference findings; do not call the widening a clean seal.
Add an inference-only mustFlag/control so removing the root causes a red or empty-population refusal.
Correct the stale zero-findings header claim.
